profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack Developer | Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch | 17+ Years Experience
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 17+ years of experience delivering enterprise-scale software solutions across federal government, healthcare, insurance, retail, utility, and financial services industries.

My expertise spans full-stack development, cloud-native architectures, and application modernization using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, React Native, and Flutter.

Throughout my career, I have:

• Led Agile development teams

• Mentored engineers and conducted technical reviews

• Contributed to architecture and design decisions

• Delivered secure, scalable enterprise systems

• Driven cloud and application modernization initiatives

Core competencies include:

• Java & Spring Boot

• Angular & TypeScript

• AWS Cloud & Serverless Architectures

• PostgreSQL & Elasticsearch

• REST APIs & Microservices

• Technical Leadership & Mentoring

• Application Modernization

• Agile Delivery

I enjoy solving complex technical challenges, improving application performance, mentoring engineers, and helping organizations modernize and scale their technology platforms.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer with responsibility for delivering enterprise-scale software solutions across government, healthcare, insurance, retail, utility, and financial services organizations. Design and develop full-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, AWS, React Native, and Flutter while leading technical design discussions and mentoring development teams.

Drive modernization initiatives involving cloud-native architectures, microservices, REST APIs, enterprise search platforms, and AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, S3, SQS, DynamoDB, AppSync, and CloudFormation. Recognized for solving complex technical challenges, improving application performance, and delivering high-quality solutions in Agile environments.

Collaborate with architects, product owners, and stakeholders to transform business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable software systems while promoting engineering best practices, code quality, and continuous improvement across development teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring Boot · Angular · PostgreSQL · Elasticsearch · Technical Leadership · Federal Government

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Led development and enhancement of enterprise web and mobile applications supporting healthcare members, providers, brokers, and internal stakeholders. Utilized Clean Code and Test-Driven Development (TDD) principles while mentoring developers, conducting code reviews, and collaborating with business leaders to deliver scalable software solutions. Developed customer-facing systems, proof-of-concepts, mobile applications, and enterprise integrations that improved user experience, operational efficiency, and access to critical healthcare information.

company.name: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Developed and supported enterprise ERP solutions using C#, T-SQL, and Ross ERP to improve operational efficiency and business processes. Designed automation solutions for inventory management, reporting, customs documentation, and compliance workflows. Created business intelligence and reporting capabilities that provided stakeholders with actionable operational insights and improved decision-making.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: Developed Louisiana State University’s Knowledge Base, also known as “Grok” (grok.lsu.edu). Used Visual Basic.net, ASP.net, and T-SQL to develop a knowledge base to help students with basic technical issues that they may encounter on campus. Developed a visual basic program that maintained statistics on the web site, featuring a built-in reporting function that graphically explains statistics.

positions.title: Computer Lab Technician
positions.description: Setup and maintained Louisiana State University’s various computer labs. Troubleshooted hardware problems and helped students with computer issues.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Tutored Louisiana State University Athletes in Visual Basic.net and SQL.

positions.title: Computer Science Teacher
positions.description: Taught students from 2nd through 5th grades in miscellaneous computer skills including office, keyboarding, and computer architecture.

projects.title: Federal Modernization Platform
projects.description: Contributed to the modernization of a large-scale federal records management platform supporting enterprise workflows. Developed full-stack solutions using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch. Designed and enhanced REST APIs, implemented search improvements, and contributed to cloud modernization initiatives. Recognized for solving complex technical challenges and improving search performance and application functionality while collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.

projects.title: Android Mobile App
projects.description: Serve as scrum master and agile coach to a high performing cross functional team responsible for developing the Android version of BCBSLA's mobile app for members to find a doctor or provider and view claim, benefit and eligibility information.
